free_text: The 68-year-old male has a PSA of 7.5 and an IPSS score of 30/35, indicating severe LUTS. Biopsy confirmed Gleason 3+3 (ISUP Grade Group 1). MRI shows a focal hypointense lesion in the peripheral zone with restricted diffusion and early enhancement, but no extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion. The management assessment is active surveillance, balancing the risk of progression against treatment benefit.
